title: Conquest Of Byzantine Empire #15
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ الله

and Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص).

خالد إبن وليد أَمَّارَهْ نَفْسَه، لَقَدْ كَانَ أبوبكر أَعْلَمْ بِرِّجَالِ مِنِّيْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ عَائَزَّنَ اللهُ بِا لْإِسْلَامْ وَإِنِّ بْتَغَيْرَالْعِزَّتَ فِيْ غَيْرِه أَذَّنْ الله

لا إله إلّا الله إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ بِالْعِيْنَةَ، وَأَخَذْتُمْ أَذْنَابَ الْبَقَرْ وَرَضِيْتُمْ بِالزَّرْعَ، وَتَرَكْتُمُ الْجَهَادَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ الله

سَلَّطَ اللهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ذُلًّا لَّا يَنْزِعَه’ عَنْكُمْ حَتَّى تَرْجِعُوْا إِلَى دِيْنِكُمْ "تبايعتم بالعينة" وتبعتم أذناب البقر وشُغِلتم بالزرع

أشهد وأنّ محمد الرسول الله إنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ بِكَ اِلَيَّ غَضَبٌ فَلَا اُبَالِي وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَكَمْتَهْ فَعَدَلْتَا فَاَمِنْتَافَنِمْتَ

ادْخُلُوا فِي السِّلْمِ كَافَّةً مَا كَانَ قَوْمٌ لِّيَخْرُجُ مِنْ مُلْكِ مُعَيْدَه’سُلْطَانَه’ بِغَيْرِ قِتَالْ وَدَاعًا يَا سُوْرِيَا اِنَّهُمْ فُرْسَانْ بِنَّهَارْ رُهْبَانْ بِلَّيْلِ

"أهل سخرٍوبحر" اَنَّهُم اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ So, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said: "اَنَّهُم اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ"

اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ وأوشكهم كرة بعد فرة وَاَكْثَرُهُم حِلْمً عِنْدَ فِتْنَةَ اشد الناس حلمًا عند الفتنة وَاَكْثَرُهُمْ اَطْفً عَلَى لمِسْكِيْنِهِمْ وَضَعِيْفِهِمْ

وخامسة حسنة جميلة Maria Al-Qibtiyyah(ماريه ألقِبْطِيَهْ).

أَمَّا بَعْدَ، فَقَدْ عَجِبْتُ لِإِبْطَائِكُمْ عَنْ فَتْحِ مصر إِنَّكُمْ تُقَاتِلُوْنَهُمْ مُنْذُ سَنَتَيْنَ مَا ذَلِكَ إِلَّا لِمَا أَحْدَثْتُمْ، وَأَحْبَبْتُمْ مِنَّ الدُنْيَا مَا أَحَبَّ عَدُوَّكُمْ

وَإِنَّ الله تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالى لَا يَنْصُرُ قَوْمًاإِلَّابِصِدْقٍ نِّيَّاتِهِمْ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ وَجَّهْتَ إِلَيْكَ أَرْبَعَةُ نَفَرٍ وَأَعْلَمْتُكَ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ مَقَامَ أَلْفِ رَجُلٍ

عَلى مَا كُنْتُ أَعْرِفْ،إِلَّاأَنْ يَّكُوْنَ غَيَّرَ هُمْ مَا غَيَّرَ غَيْرَهُمْ فَإِذَا أَتَاكَ كِتَابِيْ هَذَا فَاخْطُبِ النَّاسْ وَحُضَّهُمْ عَلى قِتَالِ عَدُّوِّهِمْ وَرَغِّبْهُمْ فِيْ الصَّبْرِ وَالنِّيَهْ

وَقَدِّمْ أُوْلَئِكَ الأَرْبَعَةْفِيْ صُدُوْرِ النَّاسْ وَمُرِ النَّاسَ جَمِيْعًا أَنْ يَكُوْنَ لَهُمْ صَدْمَةْ كَصَدْمَةْ رَجُلْ وَاحِدْ، وَلْيَكُنْ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ الزَّوَّالْ يَوْمَ الْجُمْعَةْ، فَإِنَّهَا سَاعَةٌ تَنَزَّلُ فِيْهَا الرَّحْمَةْ

وَوَقْتُ الْإِجَابَةْ،وَلِيُعَجَّ النَّاسْ إِلَى الله وَيَسْأَلُوْهُ النَّصْرَ عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ "ما ورآعك" "ألصّلاة الجامع" أَيْحَاتَ، أَيْحَاتَ أَنَا نَعَمْ

أَلْوَاجِبَاتُ أَكْثَرْ مِنْ أَوْقَاتْ وَلَا أَعْلَمَنَّا مَا أَتَا رَجُلْ قَدْ أَسْمَنَ جِسْمَه’ وَأَهْذَلَ فَرَسَ وَعْلَمُوْ أَنِّيْ مُعْرِزُوْنَلْ خَيْلَ كَعَاتِرَاذِلرِّجَاْل

فَمَنْ أَهْزَلَ فَرَسَه’ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّهْ حَطَّتُ مِنْ فَرِيْضَتَه’ قَدَرَ ذَلِكْ
english:
Tonight In sha'Allah Ta'ala(إن شاء الله تعالى) we'll move on to the second half of the conquests and that's the Roman front, remember they were dealing with two fronts.

The Persian Empire in Al-Iraq and then the Roman Empire in the land of Ash-Sham(ألشام) and this is called Ghazwa Ur Rome(غزوة ألروم), the conquest of Ar-Rome(ألروم).

Now, sometimes there could be confusion in what is meant by Ar-Rome(ألروم).

Ar-Rome(ألروم) in Arabic is a name designated to an ethnic group, it is not a land, it is an ethnic group and that is what we call today the Caucasian or the European or the white people.

In Arabic, they are called Ar-Rome(ألروم).

So, whenever you hear Hadith(حديث) about Ar-Rome(ألروم), it's not really talking about the political entity, the Roman Empire, per se.

But it was talking about a people, regardless of where they were living, because Ash-sham(ألشام) was not part of Europe.

As-Sham(ألشام) Syria, Phalastine(فلسطين), Jordan and Lebanon, but it was ruled by the Romans.

In those days, there were two Roman Empire's.

The Eastern Roman Empire and The Western Roman Empire.

The Eastern one, was called the Byzantine Empire - Al-Emaraturiya Al-Bayzantia(ألإماراتيه ألّبزانتيه).

So, Ar-Rome(ألروم) are the Caucasian people which are not the only living in Europe but they were living in those days in Russia, in Siberia

and today in America and Australia, New Zealand.

So, Ar-Rome(ألروم) or an ethnic people.

The Ahadith(احاديث) of Fittan(فتن), of the end of time say that many of the Romans will become Muslim but however, the leadership of the camp that will be fighting against the Muslims,

will be in the hands of the Romans.

So, for example, the most important war of the future which Rasool Allah ﷺ called Al-Malhama(ألملحمه), occurs between the Muslims and the Romans.

And in that Hadith(حديث), it says that many of them became Muslim, because Romans will come to the Muslims and say, hand over the prisoners that you have taken away from us.

So, the Muslims will say, No, we will never hand over our brothers.

So, this also shows that the Muslims are not fighting a nationalistic war.

It's not a war between Arabs and non Arabs, or Asians against Europeans that's not how it is.

Because the Muslims said: These are our brothers, even though ethnically they are Roman, but because they are Muslim, they are our brothers, and we will never hand them over.

Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه is the one, who opened this new front.

And the Muslims fought the battle of Yarmook(يرموك), which was a major turning point battle, in Ash-Sham(ألشام).

Al-Yarmook(أليرموك) is in present day Jordan.

The Battle of Yarmook(أليرموك) itself, the preparation was done by Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), but he passed away before the actual battle.

So, it happened in the rein of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, but it was Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) who set the grounds for it.

The next important event that happens in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), was the siege of Damascus.

Damascus was a very important town very well protected, it was surrounded by a wall which was built by the Romans, very well defended.

So, it was a key town in Ash-Sham(ألشام).

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه sent commands to his field commanders in Ash-Sham(ألشام) to the besiege Damascus and focus on it rather than focus on opening other different towns

for example, like HIMS(حمص).

So, the Muslims laid siege to Damascus.

Now, the weather in Syria is colder than the Arabian Peninsula.

So, the weather is colder than what the Arabs are used to.

So, the Romans were counting on winter to defeat the Muslim army but that didn't happened.

In fact, it was said that the Roman soldiers would be well protected, wearing boots, while the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم were wearing sandals.

Nevertheless, they survived for that entire winter.

The Roman general or, a governor of Damascus had a newborn child.

So, he held a Valeema(وليمه), an invitation, a party to celebrate.

So, they had this feast and they got drunk.

So, while they were drinking and partying, the intelligence of Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), see the commander was Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) appointed under him, Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد),

and Yazeed Ibn Abi Sufian(يزيدبن أبي سفيان), Sharhabeel Bin Hasana(شرهبيل بن حسنة) And he appointed to them different gates to the city because the city of the Damascus had more than one gate.

So, they were guarding each of these gates..

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) received intelligence of this party that the Roman governor was having.

So, while they were busy drinking, Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and his men were busy installing ladders on the wall.

And they had these hooked ropes that they would throw on top of the wall, and they would climb.

Khalid Ibn Waleed رضي الله عنه and a few of the Sahabah(صحابه), such as Al-Miqdar Ibn Amr(ألمقداد إبن عمرو) and others.

They climbed the wall, it was a small group.

They climbed the wall sneaked into town, and they started making Takbeer(تكبير), and remember that they had Miqdad Ibn Amr(ألمقداد إبن عمرو) with them.

He was one whose voice is worth a 1000 men.

So, his Takbeer(تكبير) was shaking Damascus, they took the Romans by surprise.

So, the Roman governor rushed towards Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة), he just came out of Damascus and went to Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and said; We're ready to sign a peace agreement.

They were offered, Al-Jizya(ألجزية) but they refused.

Now, he just went and told Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) I'm ready to sign the agreement, we'll pay Jizya(ألجزية).

Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) agreed because Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) did not know what was happening in Damascus.

He didn't know that Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and his men were already there.

So, while Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and his men were fighting from one neighborhood to another, taken over the town, Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) was signing an agreement of surrender, with the Roman general.

Later on, when they discovered what happened.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) has already taken over half of the town.

So, what they did was, They came to an agreement that we will consider Damascus to be a town that half of it fell by occupation and the other half was through a peace agreement.

And that's why the Muslims took half of the town including half of the Cathedral of Damascus.

This was a great huge Cathedral.

So, they decided that they're going to split everything in half including the cathedral.

So, half of the cathedral was turned into a Masjid(مسجد) and the other half remained the cathedral.

Later on, the Muslims purchased the other half and it became Al-Masjid Al Jamia(ألمسجدألجامع), which we call today Al-Masjid Al Ummvi(ألمسجدألأموي)

and this is the main Masjid(مسجد) in the city of Dimashq(دمشق).

Because what falls by force, everything is taken over by the army, however when you sign an agreement that they pay the Jizya(ألجزية), they protect their property and blood is protected.

But as they say Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) would not sleep and he would not give anybody the privilege of sleeping, he would not allow anybody the privilege of sleeping.

So, while there were celebrating he was awake and busy.

In fact, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) when he sent orders to As-Sham(ألشام) to send back an army to Iraq.

He said; You see, in the beginning there was an army in Iraq led by Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) told him to go to Syria.

So, Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and his army went to Syria.

When things were changing in Al-Iraq, Al Qadsiyya(ألقادسية), and An-Nahwand(ألنهوند) major battles.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) to send the army of Iraq back to Iraq but he said: Send them back however, keep with you Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد)

because you would need him.

So, Abu Obaidah kept Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) with him  in Damascus, in Ash-Sham(ألشام).

By the way, you might have heard of this story of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), removing Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) from his post, as the leader of the armies.

And there's a lot of fabricated stories that surround that, that there was a personal jealousy between them and they didn't like each other and they had to fight when they're young.

So, they kept this grudge against each other when they grew old - nonsense.

The reason why Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) was removed from his post was because Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه his method of governance was different than Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he gave a lot of independence to his governors.

So, financially every governor was independent from the capital of Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

So, every governor has independence and how they would collect money and how they would spend it, that was the way in the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

However, with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he wanted the financial issues to be centralized.

So, he wanted every governor, every military general to submit an account of where did he make the money and how did he spend it.?

So, he told Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), I want from you reports on how you collect your money, the Ghanaem(غنائم), the Nafel(نفل) everything

and how you spend it, Khalid Bin Waleed رضي الله عنه, did not like that, and he wasn't happy with that method.

He said: In the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), I had a dependence to collect the money and spend it the way I see fit.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Well, that's not my way.

My way is that I will hold you accountable for every penny.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: than I don't want to work for you.

And that is when he resigned and he was removed by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

That was the first removal.

However, in another battle, when Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) was under Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة).

Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) sent an army to open a particular town and Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) was with that army.

Events happened in a way where the leadership was killed.

So, Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) took over leadership, he took over leadership not because of love of leadership, but because he had to, there was nobody around to do it.

So, he came forth and he assumed leadership and then he became the governor of this new place.

When news reached Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he said; He said: It is Khalid(خالد), who appointed himself as Ameer(أمير), and may Allah have mercy on Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he knew the men better than me.

This was a man that was so capable that in this situation of difficulty, he rise to the occasion and he became the leader and he saved the Muslims at that particular day.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was saying that Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) knows the men better than I do.

However, they had another dispute on financial issues.

So, he had to remove Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) again.

And this time, there was another reason.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I want the people to know that I didn't remove Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) because I dislike him

or I'm not happy with his conduct.

The reason, why I removed him?

Is because I wanted people to know that it is Allah, Who gives victory.

Because Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) never, ever lost a battle in his life in Islam or before Islam, he was becoming a legend and he was becoming a Fitnah(فِتْنَه) for people,

people start thinking that as long as Khalid(خالد) is leading you cannot lose.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not want that flaw to enter in the hearts of men and start depending on the creation rather than depending on Allah.

He said: I wanted people to know that victory doesn't really come from Khalid Ibn Walid(خالدابن وليد), it comes from Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

So, he was protecting the Aqeedah(عقيدة) of the people protecting their Eeman(ايمان) their trust in Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and that's why he removed him.

I mean, there were stories surrounding Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), that even the enemy had all of these invented legends about him.

In one of the battles he was leading, the Roman General said; He sent a special request to meet Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), I want to see this man.

So, he met with Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and he said: I have a question for you.

And I want you to be honest with me, Tell me the truth.

Is it true that your Prophet received the sword that came down from Allah and he gave you this sword?

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: I will tell you the truth that's not true.

The reason why I am called the sword of Allah is because I was the firmest of the believers, against the enemies of Allah so, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: You are the sword of Allah.

So, we can see that legends were surrounding him, they started inventing stories about him that there was a special Divine Sword that came down from heaven

and it was in the hands of Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

And that's why Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) removed him.

Anyway, that's how Damascus was opened.

Now, was the big or the most important Ghanimah(غنيمه) and that is Jerusalem, the holy city, Bait Ul Maqdas(بيت المقدس).

Now, the Muslims did not start thinking about Jerusalem in the time Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرإبن خطاب).

You know, don't think that it was something that just happened in the time of Umar(عُمَر) the connection of Muslims to Jerusalem started from the days when Rasool Allah ﷺ was still in Makkah.

Because when Rasool Allah ﷺ went to meet Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ above the Seven heavens, he had to travel and there was no direct flight he had to make a transit in Jerusalem,

and that is Al-Israa(ألإسراء).

Rasool Allah ﷺ could not go straight to meet Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ from Makkah but he had to go through Bait Ul Maqdas(بيت المقدس).

Rasool Allah ﷺ goes to Jerusalem he leads the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) in a Salah(صلاة), in Al-Masjid(مسجد) and that is symbolic to mean that now, Muhammadﷺ is the inheritor of all the Sharia(شريعة), of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء),

he is the one to hold the torch, and he is the new standard bearer because Rasool Allah ﷺ is leading all of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) in a Salah(صلاة)

and that ceremony of handing over the leadership of the religion of Allah to Muhammad ﷺ occurs in Jerusalem, that's where he leads the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) in Salah(صلاة)

and because the Holy Land was the land of Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) that's where Rasool Allah ﷺ met them.

And Abu Bakr(أبوبكر) was thinking about it and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) thinking about it.

And Allah reserved this great bounty to the second Khalifah(خليفه) Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) Al-Farooq رضي الله عنه .

So, he sends his commands to the Muslim army to march towards Jerusalem, Amr Bin Al-Aas رضي الله عنه asked Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) how to deal with the situation

because he said, the Romans are trying to distract us, by opening up many different fronts in different towns.

What should we do?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Focus on Jerusalem and send small bands to these other locations but your focus should be Bait Ul Maqdas(بيت ألمقدس).

So, they lay siege to the town.

At-Tabri(ألطبري) mentions the story, he said, that the governor of Jerusalem sent a letter to Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) and he told him;

I advise you to go back to your land because this town is not easily conquered.
